$schema_note: Local reference data only. Not read by any print/upload code path in Phase 0/1.

pla.notes: Good default for prototypes, signage, and indoor decorative parts. Low heat resistance.

pla_plus.notes: Slightly tougher than standard PLA, similar print behavior.

petg.notes: More flexible and impact-resistant than PLA; better for outdoor or functional parts.

abs.notes: Higher heat resistance; more prone to warping. Requires enclosure for best results.

asa.notes: UV-resistant alternative to ABS; a reasonable default for outdoor/exterior parts (e.g. plate frames).

tpu.notes: Flexible filament; use for gaskets, grips, or flexible connectors only.

notes: Shrinkage values are typical/reference figures, not guarantees for a specific spool or printer.
Material choice affects clearance tolerances; see config/tolerances.json.
